step.en: Manage Template list has a 'Create Template' button for each type (SMS, EMAIL, LETTER) that opens /enotification/create-template/<type>
step.id: List Manage Template punya tombol 'Create Template' untuk tiap type (SMS, EMAIL, LETTER) yang membuka /enotification/create-template/<type>

detail.en: onCreate navigates to `/enotification/create-template/${lwType}` (lines 118-120) and the button 'Create Template' calls it (lines 137-141). App.tsx:288-301 defines the three routes email, sms and letter, each rendering CreateTemplateForm with the matching type. The button is not wrapped in hasFunction; the only gate is the server mapping OCMS_ENOTIF_MANAGE_TEMPLATE / OCMS_ENOTIF_CREATE_*_TEMPLATE in api-authorization.properties:158-163, which has create entries for EMAIL and SMS but none for LETTER (LETTER relies on OCMS_ENOTIF_MANAGE_TEMPLATE). Which roles hold these functions cannot be verified from the repo.
detail.id: onCreate pindah ke `/enotification/create-template/${lwType}` (line 118-120) dan tombol 'Create Template' memanggilnya (line 136-140). App.tsx:288-301 mendefinisikan tiga route email, sms dan letter, masing-masing merender CreateTemplateForm dengan type yang sesuai. Tombolnya tidak dibungkus hasFunction; satu-satunya gate adalah mapping di server OCMS_ENOTIF_MANAGE_TEMPLATE / OCMS_ENOTIF_CREATE_*_TEMPLATE di api-authorization.properties:158-163, yang punya entry create untuk EMAIL dan SMS tapi tidak untuk LETTER (LETTER bergantung pada OCMS_ENOTIF_MANAGE_TEMPLATE). Role mana yang memegang function itu cannot be verified from repo.

step.en: The form takes Template Name and the template body and saves with POST templatestore, with the Template Type taken from the tab
step.id: Form menerima Template Name dan isi template lalu menyimpan lewat POST templatestore, dengan Template Type diambil dari tab

detail.en: CreateTemplateForm.tsx:93-100 has Template Name (max 64) and Remarks, plus the body (TextArea for SMS; Subject and editor for EMAIL and LETTER). MapAPIManageTemplate (ManageTemplateMap.ts:208-230) upper-cases the name in CREATE mode and sets templateType from the tab. The hook POSTs to endpoint 'templatestore' in CREATE mode. The user does not type the Template Type and the UI does not add the _SMS/_EMAIL/_LETTER suffix; the officer must type it (client rule in ValidManageTemplate.ts:36-40 only checks that the name contains the type). Review: the officer must type the _SMS/_EMAIL/_LETTER suffix himself or herself and a duplicate name silently overwrites an existing template (BaseImplement.java:131, no exists check), so saving is only partly as described.
detail.id: CreateTemplateForm.tsx:93-100 punya Template Name (maks 64) dan Remarks, plus isi template (TextArea untuk SMS; Subject dan editor untuk EMAIL dan LETTER). MapAPIManageTemplate (ManageTemplateMap.ts:208-230) mengubah nama jadi huruf besar di mode CREATE dan mengisi templateType dari tab. Hook melakukan POST ke endpoint 'templatestore' di mode CREATE. User tidak mengetik Template Type dan UI tidak menambah suffix _SMS/_EMAIL/_LETTER; officer harus mengetiknya sendiri (rule di client ValidManageTemplate.ts:36-40 hanya cek nama mengandung type). Review: officer harus mengetik sendiri suffix _SMS/_EMAIL/_LETTER dan nama yang sudah ada menimpa template lama tanpa pemberitahuan (BaseImplement.java:131, tidak ada cek exists), jadi penyimpanan hanya sebagian sesuai deskripsi.

step.en: Backend rejects a Template Type that is not SMS, EMAIL or LETTER
step.id: Backend menolak Template Type selain SMS, EMAIL atau LETTER

detail.en: validateTemplateKeyFields throws IllegalArgumentException('Invalid Template Type. Must be SMS, EMAIL or LETTER') when the type is null or does not match ^(SMS|EMAIL|LETTER)$ (pattern at line 211). The create method turns it into HTTP 400 with appCode INVALID_INPUT (lines 75-80).
detail.id: validateTemplateKeyFields melempar IllegalArgumentException('Invalid Template Type. Must be SMS, EMAIL or LETTER') kalau type null atau tidak cocok ^(SMS|EMAIL|LETTER)$ (pattern di line 211). Method create mengubahnya jadi HTTP 400 dengan appCode INVALID_INPUT (line 75-80).

step.en: Backend rejects a Template Name that is not uppercase letters, digits and underscores, or does not end with _SMS, _EMAIL or _LETTER matching the type
step.id: Backend menolak Template Name yang bukan huruf besar, angka dan underscore, atau tidak berakhiran _SMS, _EMAIL atau _LETTER yang cocok dengan type

detail.en: The name must match ^[A-Z0-9]+(_[A-Z0-9]+)*_(SMS|EMAIL|LETTER)$ (line 216), otherwise 'Invalid Template Name. Use uppercase letters, digits and underscores; must end with _SMS, _EMAIL or _LETTER'. A second check at lines 111-114 requires name.endsWith('_' + type), so FOO_EMAIL under type SMS is refused. The pattern also needs at least one segment before the suffix and rejects double underscores.
detail.id: Nama harus cocok ^[A-Z0-9]+(_[A-Z0-9]+)*_(SMS|EMAIL|LETTER)$ (line 216), kalau tidak muncul 'Invalid Template Name. Use uppercase letters, digits and underscores; must end with _SMS, _EMAIL or _LETTER'. Cek kedua di line 111-114 mewajibkan name.endsWith('_' + type), jadi FOO_EMAIL dengan type SMS ditolak. Pattern juga butuh minimal satu segmen sebelum suffix dan menolak double underscore.

step.en: The rejection reason text is shown to the officer on the screen
step.id: Teks alasan penolakan ditampilkan ke officer di layar

detail.en: The controller returns HTTP 400 with the message in data.message (OcmsTemplateStoreController.java:75-80). CheckResponseError (ocmsadminui/src/utils/api/index.ts:100-101) returns that message when response.ok is false, POST puts it in res.error, the hook throws it and the alert modal shows 'FAILED. ERROR: Error: <message>'. The text is shown as is, with an 'Error:' prefix.
detail.id: Controller mengembalikan HTTP 400 dengan pesan di data.message (OcmsTemplateStoreController.java:75-80). CheckResponseError (ocmsadminui/src/utils/api/index.ts:100-101) mengembalikan pesan itu saat response.ok false, POST menaruhnya di res.error, hook melemparnya dan modal alert menampilkan 'FAILED. ERROR: Error: <message>'. Teks tampil apa adanya, dengan prefix 'Error:'.

step.en: The same validation applies to a direct API call, not only to the screen
step.id: Validasi yang sama berlaku untuk direct API call, bukan hanya dari layar

detail.en: The validation lives in the controller of POST /v1/templatestore, so any caller hits it; it runs for a single object (line 68) and for an array payload (line 61). The edit endpoint templatestorepatch rejects a changed templateName (lines 227-236) and checks templateType, so the name rule cannot be bypassed through edit. Gap outside the acceptance list: the create path ends in repository.save (BaseImplement.java:131) with no existence check, so POSTing a name that already exists overwrites that template instead of refusing it; the repo has a /templatestoreexists endpoint in the class comment but the create flow does not call it (not verified further).
detail.id: Validasi ada di controller POST /v1/templatestore, jadi semua pemanggil kena; jalan untuk object tunggal (line 68) dan array payload (line 61). Endpoint edit templatestorepatch menolak templateName yang berubah (line 227-236) dan mengecek templateType, jadi aturan nama tidak bisa dilewati lewat edit. Gap di luar acceptance: jalur create berakhir di repository.save (BaseImplement.java:131) tanpa cek keberadaan, jadi POST dengan nama yang sudah ada menimpa template itu, bukan menolaknya; ada endpoint /templatestoreexists di komentar class tapi flow create tidak memanggilnya (tidak diverifikasi lebih jauh).

note.en: Evidence is 5 Sesuai + 1 Sebagian of 6 steps (91.7 percent), counting only what the acceptance list says. Gaps the acceptance list does not mention: no duplicate-name check on create (an existing name is overwritten through repository.save), no delete function (ticket OCMS-SR-2026-163 was a DB patch to remove a test SMS template created by mistake in production), and the Create button is not gated by a function in the UI. The validation itself came from defect OCMS-DEV-2026-039 and the pen test OCMS-SR-2026-039. Which roles may create templates, and whether anything reads a newly created template, cannot be verified from the repo. No URA deck or workbook sheet for this screen is in the repo.
note.id: Evidence 5 Sesuai + 1 Sebagian dari 6 step (91,7 persen), hanya menghitung yang tertulis di acceptance list. Gap yang tidak disebut acceptance: tidak ada cek nama duplikat saat create (nama yang sudah ada ditimpa lewat repository.save), tidak ada fungsi delete (ticket OCMS-SR-2026-163 berupa DB patch untuk menghapus test SMS template yang salah dibuat di production), dan tombol Create tidak dijaga function di UI. Validasinya sendiri berasal dari defect OCMS-DEV-2026-039 dan pen test OCMS-SR-2026-039. Role mana yang boleh membuat template, dan apakah ada yang membaca template baru itu, cannot be verified from repo. Tidak ada deck atau sheet workbook URA untuk screen ini di repo.

corrections: Story text says the form 'saves with POST templatestore' and 'name that the system accepts': add that the officer must type the suffix _SMS/_EMAIL/_LETTER; the UI only upper-cases the name and does not append it.

Add to risks: POST /v1/templatestore with an existing templateName overwrites the existing template (BaseImplement.save, no duplicate check), which matters because cron jobs select templates by exact name.
Acceptance 'Backend rejects a Template Type that is not SMS, EMAIL or LETTER' is true, but from the screen the type is set from the tab and never typed; only a direct API call can trigger it.
Risk 'No delete function' is confirmed (ticket OCMS-SR-2026-163 used a DB patch); the item may cite that ticket.
